content:
[Cm9]I have always
been here
I have always looked out from be-
hind these eyes
It feels like
more than a lifetime
Feels like more than a life-
time
Sometimes I get tired of the
waiting
Sometimes I get tired of being in
here
Is this the way it has always been?
Could it ever have been
different?
Do you ever get tired of the
waiting?
Do you ever get tired of being in
there?
Don't you worry,
nobody lives forever.
Nobody lives forever
title: New machine
